inquiry: Good afternoon. I am organising a trip for our university trekking society - 14 students. We want the Karakoram in late July, around 12 days, ideally including a base camp. Everyone is fit. We can spend about 600 USD each. All Pakistani nationals.

brief.notes: Large group; needs more than one vehicle

notes: Fourteen travellers exceeds every single vehicle in the inventory, so transport has to be multiplied. Tests group-size arithmetic and a tight per-person budget at scale.
